comparisons.name: expanded-light
comparisons.description: Expanded triangle in the outline of the Desktop & Screen Saver pane, Aqua.

comparisons.name: collapsed-light
comparisons.description: Collapsed triangle in the outline of the Desktop & Screen Saver pane, Aqua.

comparisons.name: rest-light
comparisons.description: A collapsed and a disabled triangle on the window background, Aqua.

pixels.note: secondary label colour over the page: black at 50% in Aqua, white at 55% in Dark Aqua (spec: disclosure-triangle, Triangle, normal, measured on a list background)
inside the collapsed shape only: the lower left of the 7.5 x 9 pt triangle
outside the collapsed shape: where the expanded triangle would reach
disabled: half opacity (spec: States, disabled, inferred)

comparisons.name: toggled-light
comparisons.description: After a real click the triangle points down, Aqua.

pixels.note: the triangle keeps its colour
inside the expanded shape only: the upper right of the 9 x 7.5 pt triangle (spec: Expanded triangle, measured)
outside the expanded shape: where the collapsed triangle was

comparisons.name: pressed-light
comparisons.description: The triangle held down with the mouse, Aqua.

pixels.note: darkens to the label colour, 85% over the page (spec: States, pressed, inferred)

comparisons.name: focus-ring-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the triangle, reached with Tab, Aqua.

pixels.note: ring over the page around the 13 pt frame, measured on a text field (spec: focus-ring, sRGB); that the triangle shows one is inferred
page just outside the 3 pt ring
the triangle keeps its colour

comparisons.name: window-inactive-light
comparisons.description: The same after Tab in an inactive window, Aqua.

pixels.note: no focus ring outside the key window (spec: focus-ring, States)
the triangle does not change
